written.myAnswer: A system is an organized group of related components that work together to achieve a purpose. Its basic elements include objectives, components, communication among components, and the system’s environment.
Natural systems occur in nature, such as the human body. Artificial systems are created by people, such as a car. In both, components work together to perform a function.

A system is an organized group of related components that work together to achieve a purpose. Its objective is the goal it is intended to accomplish. Components perform different roles and communicate with one another to achieve that objective. The environment consists of external factors that interact with the system; the system can interact with its environment through inputs and outputs.
